recipes.name: Simple Spicy Chili
instructions: Heat the oil in a sauté pan or large pot over medium-high heat. Add the white part of the onions, garlic, and spices and cook for 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the remaining chili ingredients and cook for 7 to 10 minutes.
Taste test and adjust seasonings as desired, then divide amongst bowls.
Serve with some toasted bread on the side, and add any toppings of your choice. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use pure ground chili powder made from dried chili peppers - not to be confused with the chili powder spice blend commonly found in the US, which often includes cumin, garlic powder, and other seasonings. For the intended heat and flavour, be sure to use pure chili powder. † This plant-based product has a dry texture and resembles already-cooked ground meat. † The chipotle sauce we use is a blend of chipotle peppers with water, vinegar, and spices. It's a deep red-coloured sauce. Some chipotle sauces are mayo-based, and we do not recommend using these versions in this recipe.
Storage This chili can be stored in an airtight container and kept in the fridge for up to 4 days. Freeze for up to 2 months.
